input_plan.query: Which five Ford airbag recall campaigns rank highest by the number of complaints describing the same defect as the campaign's defect summary? For each campaign, what are the matched complaint count, the share involving crash, injury, or towing indicators, the dominant complaint severity in {minor_inconvenience, moderate_safety_event, severe_safety_event}, and the dominant remedy style in {software_update, part_replacement, other}? Sort by campaign number ascending if there is a tie.

reference_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [complaint_id, make, component_id, crash_flag, injury_count, vehicle_towed_flag, summary_text]) -> FILTER(make='FORD' AND component_id='AIRBAG') -> SEM_JOIN('Within Ford AIRBAG records, match a complaint to a recall only when the complaint narrative and recall defect summary describe the same airbag failure mechanism.', input_bindings_left={complaint_summary: summary_text, component_id: component_id}, input_bindings_right={recall_defect: r.risk.defect_summary, component_id: r.component_id}, right=( SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls AS r, [campaign.number, vehicle.make AS make, component.component_id AS component_id, risk.defect_summary, remedy.corrective_action]) -> FILTER(vehicle.make='FORD' AND component.component_id='AIRBAG') )) -> SEM_FILTER('the complaint narrative describes a concrete airbag safety event rather than a cosmetic warning-light-only concern', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Classify the complaint severity.', target_labels=['minor_inconvenience','moderate_safety_event','severe_safety_event'], input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> PROJECT([complaint_id, crash_flag, injury_count, vehicle_towed_flag, summary_text, r.campaign.number, r.remedy.corrective_action, complaint_severity: group]) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Classify the recall remedy style.', target_labels=['software_update','part_replacement','other'], input_bindings={text: r.remedy.corrective_action}) -> PROJECT([complaint_id, crash_flag, injury_count, vehicle_towed_flag, r.campaign.number, complaint_severity, recall_remedy_style: group]) -> GROUP_BY([r.campaign.number], aggs={matched_complaint_count: count_distinct(complaint_id), severe_indicator_rate: avg(crash_flag='true' OR injury_count > 0 OR vehicle_towed_flag='true'), dominant_complaint_severity: mode_with_tiebreak(complaint_severity, tiebreak='alpha_asc'), dominant_recall_remedy_style: mode_with_tiebreak(recall_remedy_style, tiebreak='alpha_asc')}) -> ORDER_BY([matched_complaint_count DESC, r.campaign.number ASC]) -> LIMIT(5) -> PROJECT([rank: row_number(), campaign_number: r.campaign.number, matched_complaint_count, severe_indicator_rate, dominant_complaint_severity, dominant_recall_remedy_style])
